cards.english_title: New York records its first measles death in 30 years
cards.korean_desc: 루이스 카운티 아이가 11월 2일 홍역으로 숨졌다. 뉴욕 접종률이 95% 아래로 떨어져 홍역이 퍼졌다.
cards.english_desc: A child in rural Lewis County died from measles on November 2, 2026. Measles spread as New York vaccination coverage fell below the 95% outbreak-prevention level.
cards.hook: New York records its first measles death in 30 years.
cards.takeaway_english: New York’s response now depends on vaccination outreach and continued testing.
cards.takeaway_korean: 뉴욕의 대응은 접종 홍보와 검사에 달렸다.

why_it_matters.english: Lower vaccination coverage can allow measles outbreaks to return.
why_it_matters.korean: 접종률 하락은 홍역 유행을 다시 부를 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Emergency rules now let more workers give vaccines and order tests.
why_it_matters.korean: 긴급 규정으로 더 많은 사람이 접종과 검사를 맡는다.

parties.label: New York health officials
parties.english: They confirmed the state’s first known measles-associated death in more than 30 years.

parties.label: Lewis County
parties.english: The rural county lost a child after the child contracted measles.

parties.label: Governor Kathy Hochul
parties.english: She expanded vaccination and testing powers during the outbreak.

views.label: New York Governor Kathy Hochul
views.english: She says falling vaccination rates show what can happen when protection against preventable illness weakens.
views.korean: 접종률 하락은 예방 가능한 병의 위험을 보인다는 견해다.

views.label: New York health agencies
views.english: They stress outreach and vaccination, while the available reports do not identify the child’s vaccination status.
views.korean: 보건 당국은 홍보와 접종을 강조하지만 접종 여부는 공개하지 않았다.

disagree.english: Some readers may want more information about vaccination status, but officials have not provided it.
disagree.korean: 일부 독자는 접종 여부를 원하지만 당국은 공개하지 않았다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 접종률이 떨어지면 지역사회는 어떻게 대응해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Binance replaces stolen funds after crypto’s biggest hack
cards.korean_desc: 바이낸스 고객 계좌가 2026년 10월 29일 해킹으로 비었다. 바이낸스는 엔지니어 노트북이 해킹됐다고 조사했다.
cards.english_desc: Binance customers saw accounts emptied during a hack on October 29, 2026. Binance’s preliminary investigation points to a compromised engineer laptop.
cards.hook: Binance replaced the stolen amount by November 2.
cards.takeaway_english: The money is restored, but the security investigation is not finished.
cards.takeaway_korean: 돈은 복구됐지만 보안 조사는 끝나지 않았다.

why_it_matters.english: The incident shows how one exchange’s security failure can affect digital assets worldwide.
why_it_matters.korean: 한 거래소의 보안 실패가 세계 디지털 자산에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Customers may still need answers about how withdrawals were approved.
why_it_matters.korean: 고객들은 출금 승인 과정을 아직 물어야 한다.

parties.label: Binance
parties.english: The exchange says it will cover the stolen funds with SAFU and company money.

parties.label: Customers
parties.english: Customers received replacement funds after the October 29 attack.

parties.label: Security investigators
parties.english: They are still looking for the attacker and examining a compromised engineer laptop.

views.label: Binance
views.english: Binance presents the rapid replacement as proof that customer losses were contained.
views.korean: 바이낸스는 빠른 복구로 고객 피해를 막았다고 본다.

views.label: Security analysts
views.english: Analysts say the size of the theft and incomplete investigation leave important security questions open.
views.korean: 분석가들은 거액의 피해와 미완료 조사가 의문을 남긴다고 본다.

disagree.english: Some may trust the repayment, while others may focus on how the withdrawal system was compromised.
disagree.korean: 일부는 보상을 믿지만 다른 사람은 보안 실패를 본다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 대형 해킹 뒤 빠른 보상이 신뢰를 회복할까요?

cards.english_title: California voters weigh a one-time billionaire wealth tax
cards.korean_desc: 캘리포니아는 2026년 11월 3일 주민투표에 40호를 올렸다. 찬성파는 세금으로 연방 의료비 삭감을 메우려 한다. 11월 3일 반대파는 찬성파보다 약 10배 많은 돈을 모았다.
cards.english_desc: California placed Proposition 40 on the November 3, 2026 ballot. Supporters want the revenue to replace federal healthcare funding cuts. On November 3, opponents had raised about ten times more money than supporters.
cards.hook: California proposed a one-time 5% billionaire wealth tax.
cards.takeaway_english: California is testing whether taxing extreme wealth can protect public services.

why_it_matters.english: The measure could change healthcare funding for Californians.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 법안은 캘리포니아 의료비를 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: California’s budget depends heavily on income taxes from wealthy residents.
why_it_matters.korean: 캘리포니아 예산은 부자들의 소득세에 크게 의존한다.

parties.label: Proposition 40 supporters
parties.english: They want healthcare funding after estimated federal cuts of $100 billion over five years.

parties.label: Governor Gavin Newsom
parties.english: He warns wealthy residents could leave and take tax revenue with them.
parties.korean: 뉴스om 주지사는 부자들이 떠날 수 있다고 경고한다.

parties.label: California voters
parties.english: A mid-October poll showed 52% opposed and 46% supported the measure.

views.label: Bernie Sanders and labor supporters
views.english: They say billionaires should pay more to protect healthcare from federal funding cuts.
views.korean: 샌더스와 노동계는 억만장자가 의료비를 내야 한다고 말한다.

views.label: Gavin Newsom and opponents
views.english: They say wealthy taxpayers may leave, harming California’s budget and economy.
views.korean: 뉴스om과 반대파는 부자 이탈이 예산과 경제를 해친다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The measure could raise healthcare money, but its effect on migration and state revenue remains disputed.
disagree.korean: 세금은 의료비를 늘릴 수 있지만 이탈과 세수 효과는 논쟁 중이다.

cards.english_title: India and Israel reject a UN regional arms-control proposal
cards.korean_desc: 인도와 이스라엘은 2026년 11월 2일 유엔 군축안에 반대했다. 초안은 지역과 하위 지역 협정에 집중했다. 인도는 유엔이 지역 군축 지침을 이미 채택했다고 말했다. 제1위원회는 기권 없이 180대 2로 초안을 통과시켰다.
cards.english_desc: India and Israel voted against a UN draft on regional arms control on November 2, 2026. The draft focused on agreements within regions and subregions. India said earlier UN bodies had already adopted guidance on regional disarmament. The First Committee approved the draft 180–2 with no abstentions.
cards.hook: India and Israel were the only countries voting against the resolution.
cards.sticker: A UN vote with two noes
cards.takeaway_english: The dispute is less about disarmament itself than about the right level for it.

why_it_matters.english: The vote shows disagreement over how countries should manage military risks.
why_it_matters.korean: 이번 표결은 군사 위험 관리 방식의 갈등을 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: The decision affects future talks about conventional weapons.
why_it_matters.korean: 결정은 재래식 무기 협상에 영향을 준다.

parties.label: India
parties.english: India said security concerns cross regional boundaries.
parties.korean: 인도는 안보 우려가 지역 경계를 넘는다고 말했다.

parties.label: Israel
parties.english: Israel joined India in voting against the draft.

parties.label: Pakistan and Belarus
parties.english: They sponsored the draft on regional and subregional conventional arms control.
parties.korean: 파키스탄과 벨라루스가 지역 재래식 무기 통제안을 냈다.

views.label: India
views.english: India says arms control should address global security, not mainly regional arrangements.
views.korean: 인도는 군축이 지역보다 세계 안보를 다뤄야 한다고 본다.

views.label: Resolution supporters
views.english: Supporters say most post-Cold War security threats arise among states in the same region.
views.korean: 찬성국들은 냉전 뒤 위협이 주로 같은 지역에서 생긴다고 본다.

disagree.english: Regional agreements may build trust locally, while India argues regional balance can be unrealistic.
disagree.korean: 지역 협정은 신뢰를 만들 수 있지만 인도는 지역 균형이 비현실적이라고 본다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 군축은 세계적으로 시작해야 할까요, 지역적으로 시작해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Indian-origin candidates spread across America’s midterm ballot
cards.korean_desc: 인도계 후보들이 2026년 11월 3일 미국 선거에 출마했다. 민주당 로 칸나 등 네 명은 재선에 도전했다. 선거는 의회와 주정부와 도시 지도자 자리를 포함했다. 공화당 비벡 라마스와미는 트럼프 지지로 오하이오 주지사에 출마했다.
cards.english_desc: Indian-origin candidates contested US elections on November 3, 2026. Democrats Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, Ami Bera, and Suhas Subramanyam sought reelection. Their races covered Congress, state executive offices, and city leadership. Republican Vivek Ramaswamy ran for Ohio governor with Donald Trump’s backing.
cards.hook: Indian-origin candidates are running from Congress to city offices.
cards.takeaway_english: The election will show which candidates turn community visibility into political power.
cards.takeaway_korean: 선거는 공동체의 존재감이 정치력으로 이어질지 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: The races show Indian-American participation at several levels of US government.
why_it_matters.korean: 선거는 미국 정부 여러 단계의 인도계 참여를 보여준다.

why_it_matters.english: Their different parties show that Indian-origin voters are not politically uniform.
why_it_matters.korean: 서로 다른 정당은 인도계 유권자가 하나가 아님을 보여준다.

parties.label: Ro Khanna
parties.english: The California Democrat is seeking another term in Silicon Valley’s district.
parties.korean: 캘리포니아 민주당원 로 칸나는 재선에 도전한다.

parties.label: Pramila Jayapal
parties.english: The Chennai-born Democrat is seeking another term from Washington.
parties.korean: 첸나이 출생 프라밀라 자야팔은 재선에 나선다.

parties.label: Vivek Ramaswamy
parties.english: The Republican is running for Ohio governor.
parties.korean: 공화당원 비벡 라마스와미는 오하이오 주지사에 출마했다.

views.label: Supporters of Indian-origin candidates
views.english: They see the races as broader representation across Congress, state offices, and cities.
views.korean: 지지자들은 의회와 주정부와 도시의 대표성이 넓어진다고 본다.

views.label: Indian-American political observers
views.english: They note that candidates do not share one party or one political agenda.
views.korean: 관찰자들은 후보들이 같은 정당이나 의제를 공유하지 않는다고 말한다.

disagree.english: More candidates can increase representation, but ancestry alone does not show what voters will support.
disagree.korean: 후보가 많아져도 혈통만으로 유권자의 선택을 알 수 없다.

cards.english_title: A school aid center was struck, killing 26 people
cards.korean_desc: 러시아 공습이 2026년 11월 2일 우크라이나 코미슈바카 구호학교를 때렸다. 우크라이나 당국은 첫 공격 뒤 대피소가 다시 맞았다고 말했다. 구조대원 두 명과 경찰 네 명을 포함해 최소 26명이 숨졌다.
cards.english_desc: Russian strikes hit a school aid center in Komyshuvakha, Ukraine, on November 2, 2026. Ukrainian officials said a first strike hit arrivals, followed by another targeting the shelter. At least 26 people died, including two rescue workers and four police officers.
cards.hook: A Russian strike on a Ukrainian aid center killed 26 people.
cards.takeaway_english: The next peace talks will begin after a ceasefire ended with deadly strikes.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 평화 회담은 유혈 공격 뒤 시작된다.

why_it_matters.english: People seeking food and aid were killed at a place meant to help them.
why_it_matters.korean: 도움을 받으러 온 사람들이 구호 장소에서 숨졌다.

why_it_matters.english: The strike weakened confidence in future local ceasefires.
why_it_matters.korean: 공격은 앞으로의 지역 휴전 신뢰를 약화했다.

parties.label: Ukrainian officials
parties.english: They said Russia struck a school distributing humanitarian aid in Komyshuvakha.
parties.korean: 우크라이나 당국은 러시아가 구호 학교를 공격했다고 말했다.

parties.label: Rescue workers and police
parties.english: Two rescue workers and four police officers were among those killed.
parties.korean: 구조대원 두 명과 경찰 네 명이 숨졌다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: Russia did not deny using pauses to regroup and said no new missions were planned.
parties.korean: 러시아는 휴전 중 재정비를 인정했고 새 구호 임무는 없다고 말했다.

views.label: Ukraine
views.english: Ukraine says the strike reversed hopes that the local ceasefire could lead toward peace.
views.korean: 우크라이나는 공격이 평화 희망을 뒤집었다고 말한다.

views.label: Russia
views.english: Russia says military forces on both sides have used pauses to regroup.
views.korean: 러시아는 양측 모두 휴전을 재정비에 이용했다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The casualty report is supported by several outlets, but responsibility for the strike comes from Ukrainian statements.
disagree.korean: 사망자 수는 여러 매체가 전했지만 공격 책임 주장은 우크라이나 발표다.
